\(l = {@decimalplaces(sqrt(height^2 + (width/2)^2 + (depth/2)^2),5)@}...\)

\(l = {@float(round_prop(10*tans1)/10)@}cm\) (to 1dp)

\(h = \sqrt{{@height@}^2 + (\frac{{@width@}}{2})^2}\)
\(h = \sqrt{{@height^2+(width/2)^2@}}\)

Therefore, the area of the blue face is given by:
\(A = \frac{{@depth@}}{2} \times \sqrt{{@height^2+(width/2)^2@}}\)
\(A = {@decimalplaces(tans2,5)@}...\)
\(A = {@float(round_prop(10*tans2)/10)@}cm\) (to 1dp)
